FRONT.label: front view
FRONT.instruction: Render the character from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.

FRONT_LEFT_3_4.label: front-left three-quarter view
FRONT_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a front-left three-quarter view. The character faces forward, they do not turn their head. Do not render this as a straight front view or profile view.

FRONT_RIGHT_3_4.label: front-right three-quarter view
FRONT_RIGHT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a front-right three-quarter view. The character faces forward, they do not turn their head. Do not render this as a straight front view or profile view.

LEFT_PROFILE.label: left profile view
LEFT_PROFILE.instruction: Render the character from a direct left profile view, showing the character's left side.

RIGHT_PROFILE.label: right profile view
RIGHT_PROFILE.instruction: Render the character from a direct right profile view, showing the character's right side.

BACK_LEFT_3_4.label: back-left three-quarter view
BACK_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a back-left three-quarter view. The character faces forward, they do not turn their head. Do not render this as a straight back view or profile view.

BACK_RIGHT_3_4.label: back-right three-quarter view
BACK_RIGHT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a back-right three-quarter view. The character faces forward, they do not turn their head. Do not render this as a straight back view or profile view.

BACK.label: back view
BACK.instruction: Render the character from a direct back view, facing away from the viewer squarely.
